text:
maria: Heads up: seeing intermittent client IP churn for EU pods — connections routed through us-east NAT ~every 2-5m. Logs show 502s from model-gw during those windows.
sam: noticed the same. GeoDNS topology shows weight shift to us-east briefly. TTLs are 30s on the geo record.
kai: Are probes failing in eu-west? healthcheck-latency shows 120-300ms spikes at same times.
maria: Probe spikes coincide with bg maintenance on eu NAT pool (ephemeral EIPs rotated). SNAT mapping drop = connections reoriginate -> different public IP -> upstream LB blacklists for a sec.
derek: If LB blacklists by source IP for hysteresis, that could explain 502s. We need sticky egress or reduce EIP rotation frequency.
sam: Options: increase GeoDNS stability (raise TTL to 60-120s + stick weights), implement NAT sticky mapping for VPC egress (per-pod affinity), or add short failover grace window in routing layer.
kai: Affinity would require maintaining 5-10k mappings — feasible but costy. Could splay EIP rotations over longer windows and add warmup probe so LBs don't blackhole.
maria: Propose: temp change - increase geo record TTL -> 90s, add probe weight hysteresis window 60s, and set EIP rotation cooldown to 10m. Canary on a subset (eu-west-1) for 30m.
derek: Agree on canary. Also suggest we add a fallback config: if probe fails <3s, don't immed switch weights; wait for 2 consecutive probe failures.
sam: I'll push DNS TTL change via route53, and update rotation in infra-scheduler. Commands:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.prod.","Type":"A","TTL":90}}]}'
```
kai: :eyes: I'll add the probe window and update LB config. Derek — can you get the cost estimate for sticky NAT mappings? rough numbers ok.
derek: Quick calc: 10k sticky mappings across regions ~ additional NAT gateway state + ~$2k/mo in IP charges and NAT gateway hours. I'll post exact in a follow-up doc. For now toggling TTL + rotation cooldown should reduce incidents.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: DNS change started by sam at 1912345690 — rollout 50% -> eu-west-1 canary.
maria: :thumbsup: monitoring dashboard shared: https://dash.company/internal/egress-eu — watching for 30m. Will post postmortem if recurrence.
